title: Model catalog filters and pin/rollout prototypes
content:
Purpose
- Capture interaction patterns and microcopy for the model catalog filters and the model-version pin + rollout UX.
- Produce a scrubbed set of wireframe notes that engineering can use to build a small prototype for testing with two internal PMs and 3 SEs.

Context + problem
- We need a way for users to find compatible model variants quickly (quantized, fp16, cpu-hosted), compare versions, and then pin a specific version to an endpoint with minimal friction.
- Current console lets you pin but UX is confusing for multi-version rollouts and for teams that want a staged canary. Also search/filter behavior is disjoint from pin flow.

Goals (MVP)
1) Fast discovery: filters + subtle affordances to guide to ‘best fit’ variant (cost/latency badges).
2) Lightweight pinning flow: select model -> pick version(s) -> choose rollout strategy -> confirm. 2 clicks to pin default.
3) Clear fallback and safety copy: what happens if pinned model is unavailable, default behavior.
4) Team controls: only named roles (admins, owners) can pin to shared endpoints; others can propose pins.

High-level interaction notes
- Catalog list view: left rail filters, top search, main card grid. Each model card shows name, default version, top-three variants (chip list), heuristic badges: avg-latency, cost-index, mem-footprint.
- Hover on a version chip shows small tooltip: latency/cost/compatibility (e.g., "latency 45ms · cost $0.003/1k tokens · cpu-only").
- Card actions: "Open details" and "Pin to endpoint". Pin CTA is primary.

Filters (left rail) — initial set
- Compute: GPU vs CPU vs TPU
- Precision: fp32, fp16, int8, 4-bit
- Quantized: yes/no
- Cost bucket: low/medium/high (derived from perf profile)
- Latency SLO: <50ms, <100ms, no preference
- Compatibility: supported on Dedicated/Private/Hosted
- Tags: semantic-search, chat, embeddings, code

Notes on filters
- Filters should be additive and sticky across navigations (persist for session).
- Show a small summary pill "3 filters" near search. Click to quick-clear.
- Filters should influence ordering: pinned/preferred models that match should float to top.

Model detail flyout
- Trigger: click card or keyboard Enter. Flyout overlays right side (width ~540px).
- Sections: header (model name + primary version dropdown), quick-metrics row (latency/cost/tokens/sec), version list (sortable by recency/latency/cost), sample prompts, compatibility matrix, changelog snippet.
- Version rows: thumbnail, version id, trained-on, size, compatibility badges, small checkbox for multi-select. A single-select radio indicates the current default for the catalog (not for endpoint).

Pin flow (wireframe sequence)
1) From card: Pin CTA -> modal "Pin model to endpoint" (small, 540px).
2) Step 1: Choose endpoint (dropdown with search). Option to create new endpoint inline ("Create endpoint") with minimal fields: name, route, visibility (private/team/public).
3) Step 2: Choose model version(s). Default: latest stable. Options: single-version or staged rollout (toggle). If staged: add up to 3 versions with weight sliders (can also use percent input). Preset quick options: Canary (5/95), 50/50, Weighted default.
4) Step 3: Fallback behavior: choose fallback strategy (auto-fallback to next highest-compat variant | queue requests | return 5xx). Default recommended: auto-fallback to next compatible variant. Microcopy: "If the pinned model is unreachable the request will automatically route to your highest-priority compatible variant to prevent downtime. This can increase cost."
5) Step 4: Access & approvals: if user is not endpoint-owner, show approval request flow: "Send pin request to owners" with message box and optional tagging.
6) Confirm screen: summary card showing endpoint, versions + weights, estimated cost impact (delta token cost per 1M tokens), expected p95 latency. Buttons: Confirm (primary) / Cancel.

Microcopy drafts (placement hints included)
- Pin CTA (card): "Pin to endpoint" (tooltip on hover: "Bind a model/version to a route for predictable serving")
- Version radio/label: "Default catalog version" vs "Pinned to endpoint"
- Fallback text under fallback dropdown: "Auto-fallback will keep traffic flowing but may route to a model with different outputs. Use canary to validate before increasing traffic."
- Approval prompt: "This endpoint is owned by <team>. Your pin request will be sent to owners for approval. Expected response time: <48 hours>."
- Cost estimate blurb: "Estimated monthly token cost (based on 1M tokens): $X -> change +$Y (approx)."

Error/edge cases
- Incompatible variant selected for endpoint type: show inline error, disable Confirm. Copy: "Selected version is not compatible with the endpoint's hardware. Choose a compatible variant or update endpoint settings."
- Rollout weights do not sum to 100%: auto-normalize with warning "Weights adjusted to sum 100%. Review before confirming."
- Pin conflicts: if another user has an active pin change in progress, show a lock with owner and ETA to completion. "Conflict: pinned update in progress by Ravi S. (2m remaining)"

Accessibility notes
- Ensure modal and flyout keyboard traps are preserved. All sliders should have numeric inputs and aria labels.
- Color badges must have text labels or patterns for color blindness.

Telemetry & instrumentation
- Track events: filter applied, search term, card open, flyout open, pin modal open, chosen rollout preset, confirm pin, approval request sent, approval granted/denied.
- Surface feedback CTA on confirm success: "Share results with team" (pre-filled slack link + summary).

Backlog tasks (alpha sprint)
- [ ] Implement left-rail filter components + persistence (FE)
- [ ] Model card redesign (badges + pin CTA) (FE/Design)
- [ ] Flyout skeleton + API contracts for versions endpoint (BE)
- [ ] Pin modal wizard with staging UI + weight sliders (FE)
- [ ] Approval flow + notification hooks (BE/Notify)
- [ ] Cost estimator stubbed service (BE)
- [ ] E2E tests for pin flow (SDET)

Open questions / decisions
- Default fallback: auto-fallback vs queue? (recommend auto-fallback for availability)
- Should we allow environment-specific pins (prod/test) or treat endpoints as environment-agnostic?
- Do we expose per-version metadata (training dataset, eval scores) in the modal or link to the model detail page only?

Notes for prototype testing
- Test cases: 1) Single-version pin by endpoint-owner 2) Canary rollout by non-owner triggers approval path 3) Incompatible variant attempt shows blocked error 4) Fallback option exercised (simulate unreachable pinned model)
- Ask SE testers to bring real endpoints that have Dedicated/Hosted to validate compatibility logic.

Appendix: rough wireframe text snippets
- Modal header: "Pin model to endpoint"
- Step labels: "1 Choose endpoint" | "2 Select versions" | "3 Fallback & access" | "4 Review"
- Button text: Primary = "Confirm and pin" / Secondary = "Back" / Danger = "Cancel"

Footer notes
- This doc is a working draft. Next sync: 2025-12-05 1pm PT with Ben, Marina, Ravi. Please drop comments inline or add to linked Linear issue CC-412.
